reader.requirement: At --std 85 a program with no OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph, not contained in a program with one, runs on the implementor-defined object computer: the compiler must accept it and apply that default (here the .NET runtime, documented in DOC-A.1-126), with the native collating sequence in effect.
reader.edition-search: The default path (no paragraph) visits no OBJECT-COMPUTER node, so VersionConformancePass's gates do not run; grep Edition|Version in ConfigurationStep.cs and the PCS resolution in SpecialNamesBinder.BindSpecialNames found no edition switch on the default. docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-126.md documents the default as the same in every edition.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-189/seqcfg.cob: SQA with PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV (END PROGRAM SQA) then separately compiled SQB with no OBJECT-COMPUTER: SQA prints A>B (REV) and LOW-VALUE IS Z, SQB prints A<B (NATIVE) and LOW-VALUE NOT Z, so the implementor's object computer and native sequence apply to a program not contained in one with the paragraph, and the configuration does not leak along a sequence (ConfigurationSource.Own inherits nothing).
